slides.body:
Time stands between you and greatness. 
Your choices decide how long.

What is measured can be controlled.
It is not that we have a short space of time, but that we waste much of it.
- Seneca

The greatest skill in 2026 is to learn to spend your time on high ROI activities.
Lost time can never be found again.
- Benjamin Franklin

Invest in your health. 
Invest in your knowledge.
Invest in your relationships.

Follow for more daily productivity tips. 🔥
